title: Huber-Wasserstein barycenters for robust distribution-valued data
abstract: arXiv:2608.13131v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We propose a robust barycenter for distribution-valued data by incorporating the Huber loss directly into the optimal transport cost. In contrast to metric-space Huber means, which apply the Huber loss to the Wasserstein distance after optimization, our construction acts on individual transport displacements, preserving quadratic behavior locally while limiting the influence of large displacements. The resulting Huber-Wasserstein barycenters form a natural interpolation between Wasserstein means and $L^1$-type Wasserstein medians.   We establish the analytical and statistical foundations of this construction. For optimal transport with Huber loss, we prove regularity and uniqueness properties of dual potentials, existence of optimal transport maps, and stability as the Huber parameter varies. translated_title: 基于Huber-Wasserstein重心用于鲁棒分布值数据
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13131v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：我们提出了一种鲁棒的分布值数据重心方法，通过将Huber损失直接纳入最优传输成本中。与度量空间中的Huber均值不同（后者在优化后将Huber损失应用于Wasserstein距离），我们的构造作用于个体传输位移，保留局部二次行为，同时限制大位移的影响。由此产生的Huber-Wasserstein重心在Wasserstein均值和$L^1$型Wasserstein中位数之间形成自然插值。我们建立了该构造的分析和统计基础。对于带Huber损失的最优传输，我们证明了双势函数的正则性和唯一性、最优传输映射的存在性，以及随Huber参数变化的稳定性。对于相关的重心问题，我们证明了存在性和表征结果、经验插入估计器的一致性，以及有限样本界。
tldr: 本文提出了一种将Huber损失直接融入最优传输成本的新重心方法，在Wasserstein均值和Wasserstein中位数之间提供鲁棒插值，并建立了其分析性质和统计一致性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel barycenter method by incorporating Huber loss directly into optimal transport cost, offering a robust interpolation between Wasserstein means and Wasserstein medians, with established analytical properties and statistical consistency.
